t.E315.agn: In 2016 EFSA saw no reason to change the existing acceptable daily intake (ADI) of 6 mg/kg body weight and found no safety concern at the permitted use levels.
t.E315.body: It is similar in structure to ascorbic acid, but its vitamin C activity in the body is very weak.
t.E315.prod: Produced by bacterial (Pseudomonas) fermentation of glucose to 2-keto-D-gluconic acid, followed by chemical steps.
t.E315.regx.0: Re-evaluated; existing ADI (6 mg/kg body weight/day) maintained, no safety concern.
t.E315.summary: An antioxidant similar in structure to vitamin C. It preserves colour in processed meats and speeds up nitrite curing.
t.E315.what: It is a structural analogue of ascorbic acid; it helps preserve colour and slow oxidation in processed meats.
